intent: One recoverable evidence spine and many role-specific projections with diversified bounded waves; achieve machine-owned operations without claiming them before tests.

one_seed.unit: work identity plus versioned exact-source manifest
one_seed.pass: One stable WorkID recoverable and deduped by independent reader

one_orb.unit: readable comprehensible human/synth projections of that same work object
one_orb.pass: Both projections render, preserve evidence and allow recovery without user as courier

one_gauge.unit: truthful machine-readable evidence state, not one global success flag
one_gauge.pass: Explicit per-transition qualifiers and evidence; no stale PASS

one_thumb.unit: single reversible public entry pointer with a fallback
one_thumb.pass: User-authorized button fires exact pointer, no truncation, one session, rollback works

one_time.unit: event, observed, qualified, landed, receiver-read clocks
one_time.pass: Actual timestamps with provenance; uncertain times null

zero_placeholders.unit: unknown represented explicitly as null or HELD with a wake
zero_placeholders.pass: No placeholder asserted as actual value or proof

sync_by_itself.unit: system-owned detection, fetch, reconcile and qualified update
sync_by_itself.pass: Independent durable receiver notices new exact source and records readproof, with no human relay

seed_survives_24h.unit: persisted object exact-byte identity plus independent read at time >24 hours
seed_survives_24h.pass: Independent receipt after 24h with same exact SHA256 from durable receiver

handoff_once.unit: one initiated handoff to an independently controlled authorized receiver
handoff_once.pass: Independent one-time exact-object pickup receipt, no human copy/paste

you_zero_system_one.unit: user relay burden zero during bounded test
you_zero_system_one.pass: Machine-owned completion and signed or attributable receipts; human gated only for consequential actions

waves.hypothesis: Recovery is possible after source relocation or session loss
waves.test: Independent fetch original exact source and recover work ID and predecessor
waves.falsifier: Recovery uses remembered prose rather than exact source

waves.hypothesis: A new human can identify state and next action without understanding internal jargon
waves.test: Blind onboarding comprehension and safe stop/rollback exercise
waves.falsifier: Participant mistakes design for running feature

waves.hypothesis: Portable package survives interruption and replay
waves.test: Rehydrate from an external receiver at a distinct time

waves.hypothesis: Independent criticism improves verified outcomes more than ceremonial approvals
waves.test: Reward reproducible flaws and compare information gain with baseline
waves.falsifier: Attack surface or noise grows without quality gain

waves.hypothesis: Two diverse projections preserve same facts without interface mimicry
waves.test: Compare machine schema and accessible human view against one frozen source
waves.falsifier: Meaning, dissent or permission disappears in translation

waves.hypothesis: Historic warning evidence can improve future experiment selection
waves.test: Pre-register future test from an independently sourced older warning
waves.falsifier: Retrodiction offered as prediction or chronology silently changed

wave_diversity_rule: Different objectives, source sets, tools, falsifiers or failure models; same mandatory privacy, evidence, reproducibility and rollback controls. No arbitrary uniqueness constraint that prevents necessary replication.

stopping_rule.bounded: Stop when expected verified marginal gain is below explicit task threshold for two consecutive distinct challenge methods, or when safety, cost, time or authority budget expires.
stopping_rule.continuity: Keep unresolved hypothesis queue, named next wake, and exact last-known-good. Do not claim exhausted global possibility space.
stopping_rule.zero_drag: Reuse source/cached proof; do not respawn work on identical prompts.

break_glass: unsupported divine or AGI operational authority
